records.title: ALK 10Q Q1 2021
records.text: Total operating revenues decreased $839 million, or 51%, during the first quarter of 2021 compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: ALK 10Q Q1 2021
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Passenger revenue for the first quarter of 2021 decreased by $822 million, or 56%, on a 49% decline in traffic and a 12% decrease in yield.

records.title: ALK 10Q Q1 2021
records.text: The decrease in Mainline passenger revenue for the first quarter of 2021 was primarily driven by a 52% decline in traffic on a 35% decrease in capacity.

records.title: ALK 10Q Q1 2021
records.text: Total operating expenses decreased $999 million, or 51%, compared to the first quarter of 2020.

records.title: ALK 10Q Q1 2021
records.text: Positive revenue and forward booking trends, combined with the benefits from cost-saving measures enacted in 2020 and the PSP wage offset, drove positive operating cash flow of $167 million for the quarter.
